LearnerProgram.name: LearnerProgram
LearnerProgram.description: Represents details of a Learning Program Plan that's created for a learner.

CatalogYear.description: The learner's catalog year, which is the year they began studying at the institution.

ClassCohort.description: The name for a group of students working through the same program at a similar pace.

EndDate.description: The date that the learner exited the program.

IsLocked.description: Indicates whether the record is locked (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

LearnerAccountId.description: The Account associated with the learner that the Learning Program Plan is assigned to.

LearnerContactId.description: The Contact record for the learner that the Learning Program Plan is assigned to.

LearningProgramPlanId.description: Learning Program Plan that’s associated with the Learner Program.

MayEdit.description: Indicates whether the record can be edited (true) or not (false).

Name.description: Name of a Learning Program Plan for an individual learner.

OpportunityId.description: The Opportunity associated with the Learner Program.

OwnerId.description: The user who owns this record.

ParentLearnerProgramId.description: The parent learner program associated with the learner program.

StartDate.description: The date that the learner began the program.

Status.description: Status of the learner's participation in the program.

EndReason.description: The reason that the learning program ended.

FeeEligibility.description: Specifies the learner's eligibility to pay home, devolved administration, or international fees.

IncomingExchangeStatus.description: Specifies the learner's status as an incoming exchange learner.

IttEmployingSchlIdentifier.description: The ID of the school that employs an Initial Teacher Training trainee.

IttEntryRoute.description: Specifies the route that the learner took to enter an Initial Teacher Training program.

LeadSchoolIdentifier.description: The identifier of the lead school that's overseeing the delivery of Initial Teacher Training.

LearnerInitiativeIdentifier.description: The ID of the learner initiative that's associated with the learner program.

NhsEmployer.description: Specifies the national code for the employer that's associated with National Health Service (NHS) funded learners.

ResearchCouncilLrnrStatus.description: The status of the learner as a UK Research and Innovation research council funded learner.

RsrchCouncilLrnrIdentifier.description: The ID assigned to the learner by a UK Reasearch and Innovation research council.

StudyIntention.description: Specifies the learner's intention to progress to a higher credential.

TeacherReferenceNumber.description: The teacher reference number that's allocated to Initial Teacher Training trainees or qualified teachers associated with the learning program.

TraineeQualifiedTchStatus.description: Specifies the qualified teacher status of the Initial Teacher Training trainee.

TransferDestIdentifier.description: The ID of the training provider that a learner intends to transfer to after leaving the learning program.

LearnerProgram.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
